items.title: CrowdStrike (CRWD) stock trades down, here is why
items.summary: Shares of cybersecurity platform provider CrowdStrike (NASDAQ:CRWD) fell 2.5% in the morning session after software stocks extended the selloff from the previous session as investors continued to reprice valuations amid mounting artificial intelligence capital expenditure concerns and decelerating software bookings.

items.title: Oracle Stock Faces Questions After $20 Billion AI Funding Plan
items.summary: In late October and early November 2026, Oracle raised US$20b through concurrent offerings of US$10b in common stock and US$10b in senior notes to fund heavy AI and cloud infrastructure spending. This included multiple tranches of fixed rate, senior, unsecured bonds with coupons between 7% and 8.65% and a US$10b equity sale at US$116 per share. items.summary: Key TakeawaysCerebras stock fell 11% in the past week to a new 52-week low, 75% below its May high. Oracle will offer Cerebras’ inference on its cloud, but a short seller and Oracle’s $20 billion raise outweighed the deal.

items.title: CoreWeave Soars 5%, Oracle Up 4% as Oracle’s $20 Billion Raise Is “Exactly What They Previewed”
